subject: why can not get the same web interface while running coding from Rstudio and open from browser

messages.author: bed7c1348ff0ff5f
messages.subject: why can not get the same web interface while running coding from Rstudio and open from browser
parts:
Dear Zhian

I meet a very strange problem that I have the following coding which runs normally in Rstudio, 

p <- plot_ly(data = pca.df, x =~pca.df[,paste0('Axis',sel.xaxis)], y =  ~pca.df[,paste0('Axis',sel.yaxis)], mode = "markers",color = ~popnames,marker=~list(size=8,color=color),text=~paste0('Ind. name= ',ind.names,"\n ,Pop:", popnames)

But error appears when I open the URL link as following: error:unique() applies only to vectors


If I change the above code to : (delete the symbol ~)

p <- plot_ly(data = pca.df, x =pca.df[,paste0('Axis',sel.xaxis)], y =  pca.df[,paste0('Axis',sel.yaxis)], mode = "markers",color = popnames,marker=list(size=8,color=color),text=paste0('Ind. name= ',ind.names,"\n ,Pop:", popnames))

It runs normally in URL link instead, but error appears when runs in Rstudio like following: error:  object color not find. 

I have no idea about it. May I ask if you know how to solve it?

Thank you in advance
Ying

messages.subject: Re: [poppr] why can not get the same web interface while running coding from Rstudio and open from browser
parts:
Hello, 

I’m not sure what package you are using, but it’s not poppr. Are you running a shiny app from someone using poppr in the background? If so, I would recommend to contact the author of that code. 

Best,
Zhian

Sent from my iPhone
